items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Pat Shaffell only in response to the interviewer's prompt about the Rabbit's Foot Troupe; the interviewee does not claim personal interaction, employment, or friendship with Shaffell, but rather identifies Hosey Sapp as the band leader during his time there.

ctx.x: Ma Rainey was with Rabbit's Foot, wasn't she? That was, yes. That way before I went on. I don't know.

That was, that was funny, in the 20s. Pat Shaffell, I saw it when I was a kid. Uh-huh. Walcott and bought the rights. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Pat Shaffell's, Rabbit's Foot. But, uh, you were with the Rabbit's Foot. Anybody that we'd know, uh, with that outfit then, do you know who had the band?

Yeah, I know who had the band. And, uh, Hosey Sapp. I heard that on that. A boy, a boy from, uh, Tampa, Florida. He, uh, he had the band. Hosey Sapp. Hosey Sapp. He had that band when I was in Jarmine. And, uh, uh, and, uh, well, originally Joe White, he was still there. I guess you heard of Joe White, he been there for the, been a rap for the, ever since he was a boy. The whole thing, Mandy Cameroy was with him once. As a drummer.
